title: Measurable cardinals: existing foundations
existing_coverage_and_exact_fact: [Ultrafilter extension](entries/filters-and-ultrafilters/entry.html#ultrafilter-extension) supplies ordinary ultrafilters under choice; [Boolean ultrafilters](entries/boolean-algebras/entry.html#boolean-ultrafilters) explain complement decisions. [Łoś's theorem](entries/ultraproducts/entry.html#los-theorem) and the [specified diagonal elementary embedding](entries/ultraproducts/entry.html#diagonal-embedding) supply transfer for ultrapowers.
remaining_scope_to_develop: Develop nonprincipal complete measures and prove the relevant ultrapowers well-founded before taking their collapses. Neither ordinary ultrafilter extension nor the completeness of the club filter establishes a measure.
